DeterminationBasis: Existing T16-008 blocks profile PASS only for a mandatory FAIL, T16-004 preserves generic claim uncertainty where proof cannot be established, and T16-009 assigns one permitted status to each applicable mandatory requirement. None establishes the specific conformance rule that a mandatory NOT_ESTABLISHED state blocks PASS unless that requirement itself explicitly permits NOT_ESTABLISHED. The requirement-specific exception is material and requires a distinct test.

Existing controls separately address mandatory FAIL blocking profile PASS, insufficient evidence producing NOT_ESTABLISHED rather than an invented positive claim, and mandatory-status assignment. None explicitly governs the stronger LILP-FULL claim ceiling across both FAIL and NOT_ESTABLISHED states. LILP-FULL therefore requires a distinct claim-level control.
